description: Department of Local  Government - Eastern Province - Declare that Mr. W. A. Yayasiri as new Chairman of Seruwila Pradeshiya Sabha In Trincomalee District
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the election and declaration of a new Chairman for the Seruwila Pradeshiya Sabha under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It contains specific electoral information including the date of the meeting, the local authority name, and the declared winner, making it clearly related to electoral processes.
